caption: The drawing depicts a round plate or bowl with a rim outlined in brown. Inside the plate, there is an illustration of a bird with outstretched wings, rendered in shades of brown and green. The bird's wings, tail, and body are detailed with brown feather patterns and green patches, and its beak is holding a long, curved ribbon or serpent-like object that stretches across the upper half of the plate. The background of the plate is a pale yellowish-beige color, giving the appearance of glazed ceramic. The composition centers the bird prominently within the circular plate, with the outstretched wings nearly touching the rim on both sides. There are some small, random brown spots and imperfections on the plate's surface, and a faint signature is visible along the lower edge of the plate.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
